text:
maria: Quick design review request  compact legend + axis unit pill + outlier treatment. thinking single-line axis labels, small unit pill, and non-destructive outlier markers. thoughts? :mag:

jake: can you share the screenshot/mock? curious about collisions when legend has long series names

maria: Figma: https://figma.com/file/zzz/compact-legend-proto (screenshot attached)

olivia: unit pill is helpful. accessibility note: pill must have full text on hover (e.g., 'millions') and an aria-label ("Units: millions"). also color alone can't indicate outlier status.

samir: outlier options: annotate with marker+tooltip (recommended) or cap values visually (opt-in). prefer annotate by default so scale isn't lost.

jake: microcopy for marker tooltip: "Outlier — 12.3M. Enable 'cap max' to compress view." shorter alt: "Outlier: 12.3M. Cap max to compress."

olivia: keyboard flow: ensure legend items tab first, then smoothing toggle, then toolbar actions. if toolbar is visually above canvas, render it earlier in DOM to preserve tab order.

maria: agreed. action items: 1) aria-label + hover expansion for unit pill; 2) legend max 2 lines, truncate with tooltip; 3) default outlier marker + optional cap mode; 4) reorder DOM for keyboard nav; 5) include a11y checklist in QA.

designbot: created issue #2589: "compact legend + unit pill + outlier marker" assigned to @maria and @samir.

samir: will prototype marker tonight and include patterned stroke for color-blind accessibility. ping when ready for quick pass. :thumbsup:

jake: small copy nit: prefer explicit prefix like "Units: USD" when the axis label isn't currency. less ambiguous for dashboards shared externally.

maria: good call  i'll include both variants in prototype for A/B. closing thread after prototypes uploaded. :sparkles:
